statement: A regular hexagonal pyramid, base 25 mm side and axis 50 mm long, rests on one of its base corners on the H.P. such that its axis is inclined at 45° to the H.P. and parallel to the V.P. Draw its projections.

placement.restingCondition: Resting on one base corner on HP with axis inclined at 45° to HP

notes: Axis true length is 50 mm in elevation; foreshortened top view axis length is 50 * cos(45°) = 35.355 mm.
